arxiv-2101-09799.description: Abstract A memory leak in an application deployed on the cloud can affect the availability and reliability of the application. arxiv-2302-13818.title: Proton Electric Charge Radius from Lepton Scattering
arxiv-2302-13818.creator: Weizhi Xiong, Chao Peng
arxiv-2302-13818.description: Abstract Proton is a bound state of the strong interaction, governed by Quantum Chromodynamics (QCD). The electric charge radius of a proton, denoted by r E p r_{E}^{p} , characterizes the spatial distribution of its electric charge carried by the quarks. It is an important input for bound-state Quantum Electrodynamic (QED) calculations of the hydrogen atomic energy levels.

arxiv-2501-19318.title: MINDSTORES: Memory-Informed Neural Decision Synthesis for Task-Oriented Reinforcement in Embodied Systems
arxiv-2501-19318.creator: Anirudh Chari, Suraj Reddy, Aditya Tiwari, Richard Lian, Brian Zhou
arxiv-2501-19318.description: Abstract While large language models (LLMs) have shown promising capabilities as zero-shot planners for embodied agents, their inability to learn from experience and build persistent mental models limits their robustness in complex open-world environments like Minecraft. We introduce MINDSTORES, an experience-augmented planning framework that enables embodied agents to build and leverage mental models through natural interaction with their environment.

arxiv-2512-15123.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mukur Gupta, Niharika Gupta, Saifur Rahman. Deep learning models deployed on edge devices are increasingly used in safety-critical applications. However, their vulnerability to adversarial perturbations poses significant risks, especially in Federated Learning (FL) settings where identical models are distributed across thousands of clients. While adversarial training is a strong defense, it is difficult to apply in FL due to strict client-data privacy constraints and the limited compute available on edge devices.
